howtos.title: Ask your AI for your most ambitious project
howtos.what: Alex Finn's 'reverse prompt': your AI uses what it knows about you to suggest what to focus on.
copy: Ask your AI to use everything it knows about you to find the most ambitious project or question you can focus on now.
howtos.whenToUse: When your AI already has memory of your work and you want help choosing what to pursue next.
